defensives.name: Aspect of the Turtle
defensives.usage_rule: Press it to negate a lethal hit, accepting that you cannot attack while it holds.

defensives.name: Survival of the Fittest
defensives.usage_rule: Press it just before a predictable damage spike to cut the hit and your pet's.

defensives.name: Exhilaration
defensives.usage_rule: Press it after you drop low to heal yourself and your pet back up.

defensives.name: Roar of Sacrifice
defensives.usage_rule: Put it on yourself or the player about to eat a big hit to bleed off part of the damage.

defensives.name: Feign Death
defensives.usage_rule: Press it to drop threat or to shed a mechanic that targets you.
